narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>For the smallest even number, I write one zero two three four five six seven eight nine.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The last digit of that number is the nine.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A number ending in nine is odd, so the slip is struck out.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Choose the last digit by the rule first.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then arrange the other digits, big to small or small to big.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The first digit of a ten digit number is never zero.
